- **Rule:** `E2E 7af56a68 flight watch` (id `e9293bf7-a4ef-419e-8f7f-05d924078d58`) is an `.es-query` rule with consumer `stackAlerts`, in the new space.
  - Index: `kibana_sample_data_flights`, time field `timestamp`.
  - Window: last 5 minutes. Fires when the count is greater than 0.
  - Query: `match_all`. The time window is applied through the time field, so no explicit range clause is needed.

The rule has no actions, so it will evaluate but won't notify anyone. I didn't add any.
